attributes.title: Seshat: original vs enriched
attributes.description: event.original (the message as received) next to the enriched fields and the enrichment provenance of every event. Syslog keeps event.original in _source (it is not indexed, so it is shown but not searchable); use the Seshat Inspect page to see the original of other inputs.

attributes.title: Seshat: where enrichment came from
attributes.description: Events that carry enrichment: seshat.enrichment.fields maps each enriched field to the origin that set it, seshat.enrichment.origins names the pack and version, knowledge-base source and connector, MIB module or OUI registry with observed_at. Both are stored flattened: filter on a key, for example seshat.enrichment.fields.seshat.device.vendor : "kb:inventory:netbox" or seshat.enrichment.origins.kind : "pack".

attributes.title: Seshat: events from senders the device knowledge base does not know
attributes.description: seshat.enrichment.level is none: the original message is all there is.

attributes.title: Seshat: device records and per-field provenance
attributes.description: The seshat.device dataset: one document per revision of a knowledge-base record, with seshat.device.provenance (<field>.source, .observed_at, .confidence). Route the seshat.device dataset to the store to use this search.
